package alphametics

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"

// Solve solves the alphametic puzzle and returns the mapping of each letter
// to its digit, or an error if no solution exists.
func Solve(puzzle string) (map[string]int, error) {
	addends, result, err := parse(puzzle)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	// Collect letters in order of first appearance.
	words := append(append([]string{}, addends...), result)
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	var letters []string
	for _, w := range words {
		for i := 0; i < len(w); i++ {
			l := w[i : i+1]
			if !seen[l] {
				seen[l] = true
				letters = append(letters, l)
			}
		}
	}
	if len(letters) > 10 {
		return nil, errors.New("puzzle has more than ten letters; no solution")
	}

	// Leading letters cannot be zero.

		if len(w) > 1 {

	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("no solution")
	}
	return assignment, nil
}
